facts.statement: OpenAI says image sizes are flexible, and names no resolution, no maximum, and no list of accepted sizes on this page.
facts.quote: It supports flexible image sizes and high-fidelity image inputs.

facts.statement: OpenAI describes the model as doing image editing as well as generation.
facts.quote: GPT Image 2 is our state-of-the-art image generation model for fast, high-quality image generation and editing.

facts.statement: Meta says Muse Image edits an image it is given, and changes only what was asked for.
facts.quote: Muse Image edits images with precision, changing exactly what the user asks for.

facts.statement: Meta says Muse Image takes more than one reference image at once and composes elements from them.
facts.quote: Muse Image can compose elements from many input reference images in the prompt, including people, objects, clothing, styles, and environments.

facts.statement: Stability AI names one megapixel as the resolution this model is intended for. The announcement frames it as the model's professional use case rather than as a hard limit.
facts.quote: This model is ideal for professional use cases at 1 megapixel resolution.

facts.statement: Tencent documents the resolution as a caller-supplied argument, with an automatic default, and gives 1280x768 as an example of an explicit size.
facts.quote: Image resolution. Can be `auto`, like `1280x768` or `16:9`

facts.statement: The same argument accepts a ratio in place of a pixel size, so the caller can ask for a shape rather than a resolution.
facts.quote: Image resolution. Can be `auto`, like `1280x768` or `16:9`
